original_title: One dead in US after being struck by taking off Frontier Airlines plane - Al Jazeera

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: A person was struck and killed by a taking off Frontier Airlines plane in the US, indicating a significant risk to aviation safety and personnel
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Investigations will likely be conducted to determine the cause of the incident, and airport security measures may be heightened
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The incident may lead to a review of airport safety protocols and procedures to prevent similar incidents in the future
ai_analysis.operational_impact: The incident may cause disruptions to flight operations and impact the safety and security of passengers and personnel at the airport
